'''Rosewood tree''' is a tropical hardwood lumber tree found on [[Drumstick Isle]], requiring 79 [[Sailing]] to dock. Chopping them is the primary source of [[rosewood logs]]. It requires 92 [[Woodcutting]] to chop.

A naturally occurring rosewood tree takes {{ticks|458}} to deplete. 

A planted rosewood tree depletes at the same rate of all planted trees, having a 1/8 chance to be cut down when a log is gathered. This can make cutting a player-grown rosewood tree frustrating unless multiple are planted in one location (currently only possible at [[Fossil Island]]) due to the likelihood of only gaining a few logs before the tree is felled and the player must wait two minutes for it to respawn.
